name: Helping The Needy
overview: Scripture commands believers to respond to the needs of the poor with open hands and compassionate hearts, recognizing that the poor will always be present among us and that withholding help hardens the heart (Deuteronomy 15:7, 11). Honoring God involves showing mercy to the needy, as oppressing them is equivalent to reproaching the Creator (Proverbs 14:31). Giving to the poor is seen as lending to the Lord Himself, who promises to repay generosity (Proverbs 19:17), and those who are generous will be blessed (Proverbs 22:9). However, such acts of charity must be done with sincerity before God, not for public recognition (Matthew 6:1).
